If you’re in and around Mira Road and want delicious vegetarian food with great variety — this place is a must-visit!

featured_reviews.review_text:
A Flavor Bomb You Shouldn't Miss!

Recently visited Subway and had an amazing experience that’s worth sharing. I went with their oregano herb bread, and trust me—it’s the perfect base! Soft, flavorful, with just the right hint of seasoning. But the real game-changer? I asked for ALL the sauces—yes, all of them—and it was a mouthwatering explosion of sweet, tangy, spicy, and creamy goodness. From the chipotle southwest to the sweet onion and classic mayo, each bite had a surprise kick.

The staff was polite and didn’t hesitate even once when I requested every sauce on my sub (shoutout to the sandwich artist for the perfect layering!). The veggies were fresh, the fillings generous, and the whole thing felt like a well-balanced flavor adventure.

Only reason I’m not giving a full 5 stars is that the seating area could use a little more cleanliness during busy hours. But taste-wise? 💯

Pro tip: Try the oregano bread with all sauces and some peri peri chicken—it’s a mess, but it’s the kind of delicious mess you’ll crave again!

Will definitely be back for another round! 🌯🔥

featured_reviews.name: Umair Lucky
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Consistent Reliable Spot for Quick Bites and Hangouts
​I’ve visited this McDonald’s multiple times, whether it’s for a quick breakfast, a late-night snack, or just a place to sit and work for an hour. Here’s a breakdown of my experience:
​The Food: 4/5
You know exactly what you’re getting with McDonald’s, and this branch delivers on that consistency.
​The Classics: The McAloo Tikki and McSpicy Chicken were fresh, with the buns being soft and toasted just right.
​The Fries: This is usually the dealbreaker. Most of the time, they are hot, crispy, and perfectly salted. However, during peak Sunday rush hours, I’ve occasionally received a batch that was a bit limp. Pro tip: always check them before you leave the counter!
​Desserts & Coffee: The McFlurry Oreo is a must-have. I also tried the McCafe Cold Coffee—it's surprisingly good for the price and much better than what you’d get at most fast-food joints.
​Service & Efficiency: 3/5
This is where there’s some room for improvement.
​Ordering: The self-service kiosks are a lifesaver. They make customizing your burger (like removing pickles or adding extra cheese) much easier.
​Wait Time: During weekdays, the service is lightning-fast. However, on weekend evenings, the place gets chaotic. I waited about 15–20 minutes for a simple meal last Saturday because the staff seemed overwhelmed by the influx of delivery orders (Zomato/Swiggy) alongside the dine-in crowd.
​Staff: Generally polite and helpful, though they are clearly under a lot of pressure during peak hours.
​Ambiance & Cleanliness: 4/5
​Vibe: It’s a lively, family-friendly atmosphere. It’s also a popular spot for students, so it can get a bit noisy, but that’s expected.
​Hygiene: The dining area is usually kept clean; staff are quick to wipe down tables once people leave. However, the washroom maintenance could be better, especially during the busy night shifts.
​Final Verdict:
Whether you're looking for a budget-friendly meal or a nostalgic snack, this McDonald’s is a solid choice. It’s not "fine dining," but it’s reliable, clean, and the food is always familiar.
​Recommendation: Try the Piri Piri Fries and the Spicy Paneer Wrap. Also, if you’re visiting on a weekend, try to go before 7:00 PM to avoid the massive queue!

featured_reviews.name: KRISH DAVE
featured_reviews.review_text:
4/5 stars. Overall a pretty good experience at McDonald’s. The food quality is consistent, service is usually fast, and the staff is decent. The burgers, fries, and beverages taste good and are reliable if you want a quick meal or snack. The outlet is generally clean and has a nice atmosphere for hanging out with friends or just relaxing for a while.

The only reason for deducting 1 star is that the self-order machines are often out of service, which can get frustrating during rush hours because it increases waiting time at the counters. Fixing and maintaining those machines properly would make the experience much smoother. Apart from that, overall a good and dependable place to eat.

featured_reviews.name: NADEEM P
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely the Worst McDonald’s I’ve Ever Visited – Avoid at All Costs

This is by far the worst McDonald’s location I have ever been to — and I’ve visited many around the world. But This experience was beyond disappointing.

Filthy Environment: The floor was disgusting, with visible dirt and trash. There was no sign of cleaning or upkeep.
No Working AC: The entire place was hot, humid, and uncomfortable, making it nearly unbearable to sit and eat.
Disgusting Washroom: The restroom had no door, was wide open, and the stench could be smelled across the dining area. It was completely unhygienic.
Unprofessional Staff: The staff were incredibly rude and seemed uninterested in helping or providing any sort of customer service.
Poor Food Quality: I ordered a Happy Meal — it came without the box, without the toy, and to make things worse, the chicken nuggets were raw inside. Absolutely unacceptable.
•	Zero Cleanliness Standards: Compared to even the most basic local restaurants, this McDonald’s location falls far below standard.

This place should be inspected for health and safety violations. I’m shocked it’s allowed to operate under the McDonald’s brand. Truly a disgrace.

Respond for your reply

I’ve visited many McDonald’s locations globally, and this was by far the worst experience I’ve had. I hope you take this feedback seriously and not just as a formality.
